farai.03.quote: FAR AI was selected by the European Commission's AI Office to lead Lot 1 (CBRN Risk Modelling and Evaluation)
farai.03.note: Regulator as client setting scope by tender: 3 (S.3). S.4/S.5: no statutory power or sign-off right, so not 4.

farai.04.quote: we've published groundbreaking research on adversarial robustness, interpretability, and red-teaming
farai.04.note: "Publishes" with no statement about who reviews before publication floors at 2 (R.7). far-transparency (not cited here) says FAR.AI retains the right to publish non-confidential insights and has turned down restrictive contracts, which would support 3 if cited as a no-lab-review statement; R.5 (4) would further need documented adverse findings without pre-review.

farai.05.quote: FAR.AI is an independent nonprofit research organization
farai.05.note: Legal form alone floors at 2 (G.1). far-transparency publishes one of the four G.2 items (disclosure of the revenue fraction from for-profit developers) plus a 10% revenue cap, but no recusal rule, no no-contingent-fee rule and no side-grant rule, so G.2's two-item test is not met on the record; a recusal or contingent-fee rule would lift the floor to 3.

farai.06.quote: FAR AI began red-teaming leading language models for frontier labs in Q4 2023, including red-teaming of GPT-4
farai.06.note: Pre-release red-teaming is anchor 1 unless safeguards-off or extended-window access is documented (anchor 2); neither is in the cited source. The EU AI Office contract is a regulator engagement, not lab-granted access, so A.4 (government agreements: 3) is not applied; recorded as a rule-reading gap because A.4's wording does not say it is limited to public bodies. Document request: the terms of the GPT-5 pre-release red-teaming (80 hours per the system card, ledger R12).

farai.07.note: The source describes field-building, fellowship and internship programs but never says participants are placed into labs, so no span and weak support. Applied P.3 (two-way movement without a cooling-off rule) by analogy, recorded as a gap: program placements are not staff hiring. If the claim is dropped, P has no signal and is unevidenced.

farai.08.quote: we've published groundbreaking research on adversarial robustness, interpretability, and red-teaming
farai.08.note: Papers and methods in prose: 2 (M.2). FAR.AI releases code on GitHub (AlignmentResearch), which would floor at 3 under M.1 if cited; not in the cited source.

farai.09.quote: FAR AI conducts empirical technical AI safety research without developing or deploying AI products of its own
farai.09.note: No products: floor 3 (X.4 territory). The claim's "consulting limited to governments" is contradicted by far-transparency, which describes consulting for for-profit frontier developers at market rates (new signal farai.15, X.3 cap 2). X.7 (4) is unavailable while paid consulting for labs exists.

farai.10.quote: is capped at a maximum of 10% of FAR.AI's total annual revenue
farai.10.note: Existing quote found. A published policy capping lab revenue at 10%, at market rates, with publication rights retained lifts the fee cap from 2 to 3 (F.3); as a for-signal it floors at 3 (earned revenue $429K of $24.3M in TY2024).

dissent.lower: Access could be 0. No cited source records the terms of any lab engagement: the wiki says FAR.AI began red-teaming leading models for frontier labs in late 2023 and that publicly confirmed engagements include OpenAI, but neither it nor the $30M post shows pre-release checkpoints, safeguards off, or logs. Anchor 0 is public API only, and that is all the record demonstrates; the EU contract is a regulator engagement, not lab access.
dissent.higher: Access could be 2. OpenAI's GPT-5 system card credits FAR.AI with 80 hours of red-teaming before release, and pre-release red-teamers typically test early checkpoints under relaxed safeguards; the transparency page describes engagements with companies building frontier models under NDA. If the engagement terms show safeguards off or extended windows, anchor 2 applies, and helpful-only or log access would reach 3.
